Minions.name: Bear
Minions.description: Big, cuddly, but don’t steal its snacks!

Minions.name: Cat
Minions.description: Self-proclaimed ruler of the game. You serve it now.

Minions.name: Goat
Minions.description: Climbs anything, eats everything, fears nothing! This hoofed hooligan is chaos on four legs!

Minions.name: Cow
Minions.description: Chill, chunky, and full of charm. This cow loves naps, snacks, and occasional stampedes when nobody’s looking.

Minions.name: Deer
Minions.description: Graceful, speedy… scared of literally everything.

Minions.name: Dog
Minions.description: Loyal, goofy, and always chasing things he’ll never catch, like his own tail. Your new best buddy!

Minions.name: Frog
Minions.description: Bright, bouncy, and possibly poisonous! This little hopper’s got big jumps, loud croaks, and zero chill. Ribbit!

Minions.name: Jaguar
Minions.description: Silent, sleek, and faster than your Wi-Fi! This jungle ninja strikes hard, naps harder, and always looks cool doing it

Minions.name: Rabbit
Minions.description: Hops around like it drank five energy drinks.

Minions.name: Beaver
Minions.description: This overly enthusiastic log-chewer thinks everything is a dam project. Will chew your enemies’ defenses… or your furniture

Minions.name: Badger
Minions.description: Nature’s grumpy garden gnome. Digging tunnels, fighting bees, and looking perpetually annoyed since forever.

Minions.name: Caiman
Minions.description: A crocodile’s sneaky cousin who lurks like it’s always planning a prank — and maybe it is.

Minions.name: Capybara
Minions.description: The chillest creature alive. Basically a furry potato that vibes with everyone. Even caimans

Minions.name: Crab
Minions.description: Tiny sideways tank. Pinches first, asks questions never. Sandcastle destroyer by trade.

Minions.name: Dolphin
Minions.description: A smiley ocean genius who surfs waves and judges your intelligence. Secretly plotting something.

Minions.name: Duck
Minions.description: Quack-powered chaos in a feathery tuxedo. Cute, loud, occasionally terrifying.

Minions.name: Iguana
Minions.description: Lounge lizard with a mohawk. Too cool to move fast. Loves sunbathing and salad.

Minions.name: Moose
Minions.description: A majestic forest horse with tree-branch antlers and zero understanding of personal space.

Minions.name: Otter
Minions.description: Floating fuzzballs who hold hands, crack shellfish, and look like they’re in a soap opera.

Minions.name: Owl
Minions.description: Feathered librarian of the woods. Sees all. Knows all. Might judge your grammar.

Minions.name: Raccoon
Minions.description: Trash panda extraordinaire. Masked like a bandit, snacks like a king.

Minions.name: Seagull
Minions.description: Loud beach hooligan with a hunger for fries and no respect for picnics.

Minions.name: Shark
Minions.description: Toothy sea missile. Not evil, just misunderstood and really into cardio.

Minions.name: Toucan
Minions.description: Flying rainbow with a fruit slicer for a face. Lives in style, squawks in stereo.

Minions.name: Bat
Minions.description: Tiny night goblin with built-in sonar and a flair for the dramatic.

Minions.name: Axolotl
Minions.description: Smiling water gremlin that refuses to grow up, literally.

Minions.name: Squirrel
Minions.description: Hyperactive tree ninja with acorn hoarding issues.

Minions.name: Red Fox
Minions.description: Ginger floof who’s sure a dramatic tail swish can solve literally anything.

Minions.name: Flamingo
Minions.description: Standing on one leg because drama is a lifestyle.

Minions.name: Monkey
Minions.description: Pocket rocket in a fur coat, buzzing from vine to vine while inventing brand-new jungle sound effects

Minions.name: Horse
Minions.description: Mane-whipping wind machine posing for epic photos, then sideways-jumping at imaginary ghosts just for fun

Minions.name: Zebra
Minions.description: Stripey horse with commitment issues. Can’t pick black or white, so went with both.

Minions.name: Giraffe
Minions.description: Walking skyscraper with spots, sass, and zero neck control.

Minions.name: Lion
Minions.description: Savanna’s drama king. Big hair, big roar, bigger ego.

Quests.small_story: Ah, perfect timing! I’ve got a small project going, but I’m short on {resource}. They’re not too far, just tricky to spot. Want to give it a shot?
Hi there! I would need {resource} for my pie! Can you help me out?
Hey fellow! I really need to find {resource} to feed my pets, but they are exhausted! Could you help me with that?
Look, I’d go find the {resource} myself, but last time I got stuck in a bush and my dignity hasn’t recovered. Mind giving it a shot?
Ahoy wandering trekker! Village druids crave fresh {resource} for dawnlight brew—will you lead your pets to harvest it?
Well met hiker! I bet I’d collect rare {resource}, then tripped on my own shoelace. Could you help my companions grab some?
Hey adventurer! I’m in need of {resource}, but Mr.Happy was supposed to gather it and got distracted scrolling on his phone...I’d really appreciate the help of your pets!
Ah, just the person I needed! I promised Ms.Happy I’d find some {resource}, but I got caught up inspecting a rock. Think your pets can help gather some before she notices?
Hey explorer! The snack stand is out of {resource}; my critters are busy skipping stones. Will you steer them to pick a bunch?
Oh cute pets! I’ve been trying to gather some {resource}, but my own pets are more into napping than helping. Yours seem sharp, think they can fetch a few for me?
Greetings explorer! I lost the basket for {resource}, so my companions fill their pockets instead. Could you step in?
Hey! I’m on a mission to find {resource}... mostly because I lost the last batch behind a rock. Or maybe a goat took it? Either way, I need help.
Ho there, woodland rover! Our herb master is out of healing {resource}. Can you guide the beasts to pick a satchel?
Greetings trail trekker! My companions formed a dance circle instead of gathering {resource}. Could you guide them?
Phew...you’re here! I started a bet that I could gather {resource} in record time... but I forgot how bad I am at gathering anything. Can you save my reputation?
Hello ridge runner! I lost the sack of {resource}; pets now kick them like soccer balls. Help me gather replacements?
Perfect timing! I was off to find {resource}, but I tripped over my map. Mind grabbing them before my dignity takes another hit?
Hi adventurer! Grandfather’s recipe calls for fresh {resource}, but my companions doodle maps. Care to collect?
Okay, don’t panic! Well, maybe panic a little. I’m running out of time and I still don’t have enough {resource}. If you’re fast, we might just make it!
Hey fearless hiker! The campfire stew needs {resource}, but companions rehearse a dance routine. Can you fetch them?
Salutations, fearless trekker! My puppy pack chases shadows instead of collecting {resource}; care to round them up for a haul?
Hey, no time to chat! I need some {resource} before they vanish! I’d go, but I may have… tied my boots together. Can you get them, fast?
Hey! My pets just stole my last bit of {resource} and now they are looking at me like I ruined snack time. Mind grabbing a few more before they start a revolt?
Hey fearless adventurer! The pie fair needs fresh {resource}, and my pets are busy dancing. Rally them and bag some quick?
Good day traveler! We’re late delivering {resource}, and pets keep counting clouds. Could you lead the harvest?
Well met, explorer! It’s not much, but I’ve got a recipe that needs a pinch of {resource} and I'm a bit in rush. Without it, the whole thing falls apart. Can you track some down?
Hey, adventurer! I need {resource} for a stew I’m cooking up for the journey ahead. Send your pets out to gather some, and I’ll reward you to kick off your adventure!
Hey! I need some {resource}! Long story short, I tried to juggle them, and now they’re everywhere. If your pets could round them up, I promise not to juggle again.Probably...
